tools.name: succeed
tools.description: Return a successful result immediately. Produces a 200 EXIT signal in dispatch.

tools.name: fail
tools.description: Raise an exception to produce a 500 EXIT signal in dispatch. Error content is nonce-tagged in the signal window.

tools.name: succeed_after
tools.description: Wait a configurable number of seconds, then return success. Combine with fail() in a batch to test mixed exit states.
